pragma solidity 0.8.16;

/**
 * @title  IRegistrar
 * @author Ondo Finance
 * @notice Interface for registrar contracts that configure tokens on deployment
 */
interface IRegistrar {
  /**
   * @notice Register a token with the registrar
   * @param  token The address of the token to register
   */
  function register(address token) external;
}

params.beacon: The address of the beacon contract
params.compliance: The address of the OndoComplianceGMView contract
params.name: The name of the token
params.proxy: The address of the deployed token proxy
params.tokenPauseManager: The address of the token pause manager contract

params.newTokenManagerRegistrar: The new token manager registrar address
params.oldTokenManagerRegistrar: The old token manager registrar address

params.newTokenPauseManager: The new token pause manager address
params.oldTokenPauseManager: The old token pause manager address

params.status: The status of the ticker (true if set, false if cleared)
params.ticker: The ticker that was set or cleared

params._bridgeRegistrar: The address of the bridge registrar
params._compliance: The address of the OndoComplianceGMView contract
params._tokenManagerRegistrar: The address of the token manager registrar
params._tokenPauseManager: The address of the token pause manager
params.guardian: The address to receive admin roles (expected to be a multisig)

params.name: The name of the token
params.tokenAdmin: The address that will receive admin rights on the token

returns._0: The address of the deployed token proxy

params.name: The name of the token
params.tokenAdmin: The address that will receive admin rights on the token

returns._0: The address of the deployed token proxy

getRoleAdmin(bytes32).details: Returns the admin role that controls `role`. See {grantRole} and {revokeRole}. To change a role's admin, use {_setRoleAdmin}.

getRoleMember(bytes32,uint256).details: Returns one of the accounts that have `role`. `index` must be a value between 0 and {getRoleMemberCount}, non-inclusive. Role bearers are not sorted in any particular way, and their ordering may change at any point. WARNING: When using {getRoleMember} and {getRoleMemberCount}, make sure you perform all queries on the same block. See the following https://forum.openzeppelin.com/t/iterating-over-elements-on-enumerableset-in-openzeppelin-contracts/2296[forum post] for more information.

getRoleMemberCount(bytes32).details: Returns the number of accounts that have `role`. Can be used together with {getRoleMember} to enumerate all bearers of a role.

grantRole(bytes32,address).details: Grants `role` to `account`. If `account` had not been already granted `role`, emits a {RoleGranted} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

renounceRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from the calling account. Roles are often managed via {grantRole} and {revokeRole}: this function's purpose is to provide a mechanism for accounts to lose their privileges if they are compromised (such as when a trusted device is misplaced). If the calling account had been revoked `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must be `account`.

revokeRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from `account`. If `account` had been granted `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role.

params._tokenManagerRegistrar: The new token manager registrar address

params._tokenPauseManager: The new token pause manager address

BridgeRegistrarCantBeZero().notice: Error thrown when attempting to set the bridge registrar to zero address

ComplianceCantBeZero().notice: Error thrown when attempting to set the compliance contract to zero address

TickerAlreadyExists().notice: Error thrown when attempting to deploy a token with an already existing ticker

TokenManagerRegistrarCantBeZero().notice: Error thrown when attempting to set the token manager registrar to zero address

TokenPauseManagerCantBeZero().notice: Error thrown when attempting to set the token pause manager to zero address

NewBridgeRegistrarSet(address,address).notice: Emitted when a new bridge registrar contract is set

NewComplianceSet(address,address).notice: Emitted when a new OndoComplianceGMView contract is set

NewGMTokenDeployed(address,address,strin.notice: Emitted when a new GM token is deployed (regardless of registration)

NewTokenManagerRegistrarSet(address,addr.notice: Emitted when a new token manager registrar contract is set

NewTokenPauseManagerSet(address,address).notice: Emitted when a new token pause manager contract is set

TickerSet(string,bool).notice: Emitted when a ticker is set or cleared

CONFIGURER_ROLE().notice: Role used for configuring the factory

DEPLOYER_ROLE().notice: Role used for deploying new tokens

PAUSER_ROLE().notice: Role used to pause the factory

UNPAUSER_ROLE().notice: Role used to unpause the factory

beacon().notice: Address of the beacon contract used for proxy deployments

bridgeRegistrar().notice: Address of the bridge manager registrar contract

clearTicker(string).notice: Clears a ticker in the edge case where we need to deploy a token         with the same ticker as a previously deployed token

constructor.notice: Initializes the factory with required addresses and sets up roles

deployAndRegisterToken(string,string,add.notice: Deploys a new GM token and registers it with both bridge and token manager

deployGmTokenIsolated(string,string,addr.notice: Deploys a new GM token without registering it anywhere

pause().notice: Pauses the factory, disabling new deployments

setTokenManagerRegistrar(address).notice: Updates the token manager registrar address

setTokenPauseManager(address).notice: Updates the token pause manager address

tickerExists(string).notice: Indicates if a token with the same ticker already exists

tokenManagerRegistrar().notice: Address of the token registrar contract

tokenPauseManager().notice: Address of the token pause manager contract

unpause().notice: Unpauses the factory, enabling new deployments

userdoc.notice: This contract serves as a factory for deploying and configuring GM tokens with         built-in compliance and pause management.         This contract allows for:         - Deploying new GM tokens with preconfigured compliance and pause management         - Registering the tokens for use via with bridge and token manager registrars         - Isolated token deployments without registrar integration
